summary: Use wall time for open usage inventory periods on empty or idle members

replay.detail: Graph admission and action replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: Database, projections and wire contracts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Optional usage subscriptions without until_ms now end at wall time, matching the authorized HTTP usage read. A period starting after the last graph commit no longer fails on an empty or idle member. Explicit period boundaries retain their behavior.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon replacement applies the correction.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration is needed.

recovery.detail: Reconnecting obtains a current open-period snapshot even when no graph write has occurred. Existing subscription authorization, commit-driven refresh and bounded read scheduling remain unchanged.
